ownership.quote: We're second-time founders, with decades of combined experience at Twilio, Stripe and Retool. We work out of a converted warehouse next to Tartine Manufactory in San Francisco.

stage.quote: We're excited to announce that we've raised $2.7M in seed funding led by Matrix Partners with participation from 43 and a handful of our favorite angels to continue building the best platform for running LLM-generated code.
stage.note: Only one priced round has been publicly disclosed (seed, April 2025). No later round found; hosted product later shut down (2025-10-01).

note: Founded by Andrew Benton (CEO) and Kyle Conroy Gray (CTO), second-time founders with backgrounds at Twilio, Stripe and Retool. Raised a $2.7M seed round (April 2025, led by Matrix Partners) to build LLM-code-execution tooling. Despite the raise, the company shut down its hosted Code Interpreter API: new signups closed 2025-07-28, microVM custom runtimes deprecated 2025-08-01, and api.riza.io/dashboard.riza.io shut down entirely on 2025-10-01. Only the self-hosted (licensed) container continues. No accelerator affiliation found (not a YC company despite the AI-sandbox space overlap).
